name: dev.proxylane/proxylane
title: ProxyLane
description: Residential and ISP proxies for AI agents: create proxy lists, test connections, check IPs

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: [Account] Show both products of the signed-in ProxyLane account. residential: pay-per-GB rotating or sticky traffic with exact bytes, readable amounts, readiness and saved lists; balance_synced_at and balance_stale describe freshness. isp: Native ISP static IPs rented per month from a USD balance, with available and reserved dollars and order counts. Also IP reputation checks left today. Call this first.

tools.name: check_ip_reputation
tools.description: [Account] Look up Scamalytics fraud scores for up to 20 IP addresses: 0 is clean, 100 is risky. Results are cached for 24 hours; new lookups count toward the daily limit shown by get_account. Works for any IP, including Native ISP IPs.

tools.name: residential_top_up
tools.description: [Residential] Get a checkout link to buy residential traffic. Give the number of GB; the person opens the link, chooses card, PayPal or crypto and pays. Traffic never expires. Nothing is charged by this tool.

gb.description: Gigabytes to buy, 1 to 1000. Larger packages cost less per GB.

promo_code.description: Optional promo code, applied on the checkout page.

tools.name: residential_get_usage
tools.description: [Residential] Traffic used per hour or per day (UTC), including empty periods. Exact bytes and readable B/KB/MB/GB amounts avoid rounding small usage to zero. usage_synced_at and usage_stale describe freshness; recent requests may appear after the next sync.

granularity.description: hour or day. Defaults to day.

periods.description: How many periods back, including the current one. Up to 168 hours or 90 days. Defaults to 24 hours or 30 days.

tools.name: residential_list_locations
tools.description: [Residential] Find targeting codes. Without filters it returns countries. Add country to get its regions, cities and ISPs; add region or city to narrow cities and ISPs. Use the returned codes in residential_create_connections.

country.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, for example US.

region.description: Numeric region code returned for the country.

city.description: City code returned for the country or region.

tools.name: residential_create_connections
tools.description: [Residential] Generate residential proxy connections with the same options as the dashboard: location (country, region, city, ZIP, ISP, ASN), protocol, session mode and gateway. For one IP per account or browser profile, use session_mode sticky with session_prefix (acc gives acc01, acc02...). Output as JSON, a text export format, or proxy objects for Dolphin Anty, AdsPower or Octo Browser. Set save_as_list to keep them in the dashboard.

country.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, for example US. Leave empty for worldwide.

region.description: Numeric region code from residential_list_locations, for example the code of Texas.

city.description: City code from residential_list_locations, for example Houston or New-York.

zip.description: ZIP or postal code. Requires country.

session_mode.description: sticky keeps one IP while the device stays online, timed keeps it for ttl seconds, rotating changes IP on every request. Defaults to sticky.

ttl.description: Session length in seconds for timed sessions, up to 259200 (72 hours).

session_id.description: Letters and digits only, up to 64 characters. The same session id returns the same IP while it lasts.

gateway.description: Entry gateway closest to the machine that will use the proxy. Defaults to europe.

port.description: First port. Each extra connection uses the next port.

count.description: How many connections to generate. Defaults to 1.

session_prefix.description: Name sessions predictably: acc gives acc01, acc02... Letters and digits only. Sticky and timed modes only.

format.description: json (default) for connection objects; url, txt, csv, user-host, host-user, user-first, host-first or custom for a text export; dolphin, adspower or octo for proxy objects shaped for that antidetect browser API.

template.description: Line template for the custom format, using %ip%, %port%, %login%, %password%, %protocol% and %url%.

save_as_list.description: Save these connections as a list in the dashboard. Defaults to false.

tools.name: residential_check_connection
tools.description: [Residential] Connect through a proxy and report the exit IP, location and optionally the Scamalytics fraud score. With max_score on a sticky or timed session, retry risky IPs in the same target location up to max_attempts. Use the returned connection only when ok is true. If no IP meets the threshold, return a tool error with status threshold_not_met and no connection credentials.

country.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, for example US. Leave empty for worldwide.

region.description: Numeric region code from residential_list_locations, for example the code of Texas.

city.description: City code from residential_list_locations, for example Houston or New-York.

zip.description: ZIP or postal code. Requires country.

session_mode.description: sticky keeps one IP while the device stays online, timed keeps it for ttl seconds, rotating changes IP on every request. Defaults to sticky.

ttl.description: Session length in seconds for timed sessions, up to 259200 (72 hours).

session_id.description: Letters and digits only, up to 64 characters. The same session id returns the same IP while it lasts.

gateway.description: Entry gateway closest to the machine that will use the proxy. Defaults to europe.

port.description: First port. Each extra connection uses the next port.

reputation.description: Also look up the Scamalytics fraud score of the exit IP (0 is clean, 100 is risky). Counts toward the daily limit.

max_score.description: Highest acceptable fraud score. Implies reputation. A higher score on a sticky or timed session triggers a new session in the same location.

max_attempts.description: How many sessions to try when max_score is set. Defaults to 3.

tools.name: residential_list_proxy_lists
tools.description: [Residential] List the proxy lists saved in the dashboard (up to 50), with location, ports and rotation. Use an id with residential_get_proxy_list_connections or residential_manage_proxy_list.

tools.name: residential_get_proxy_list_connections
tools.description: [Residential] Get every connection of a saved list as JSON, a text export format, or proxy objects for Dolphin Anty, AdsPower or Octo Browser.

format.description: json (default), a text export format, or dolphin, adspower or octo proxy objects.

template.description: Line template for the custom format, using %ip%, %port%, %login%, %password%, %protocol% and %url%.

tools.name: residential_manage_proxy_list
tools.description: [Residential] Rename a saved list, change how often its IPs rotate, or delete it. Deleting a generated list (id starts with g-) removes the saved entry only; credentials already exported keep working. Deleting other lists revokes their list connections. The response states whether connections were revoked.

rotation.description: For rotate: -1 keeps each IP while the device is online, 0 rotates on every request, a positive number rotates after that many seconds.

tools.name: isp_list_products
tools.description: [Native ISP] List static ISP IP products: country, use case, description, monthly price per IP, rental terms, order limits and stock. Each IP is dedicated to one buyer and stays the same for the whole term. Discounts: 5% from 10 IPs, 10% from 25 IPs, plus 5% for 60 days, 10% for 90 days or 15% for 360 days. Pass a product id to isp_quote_order.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, for example US.

tools.name: isp_quote_order
tools.description: [Native ISP] Price an order of static ISP IPs before buying: subtotal, volume, term and promo discounts, total, USD balance after the order and any shortfall. When the balance is short, returns add_funds_url for the missing amount. Nothing is reserved or charged; the person places the order at order_url.

product.description: Product id from isp_list_products, for example isp_us_social.

quantity.description: Number of IPs. Subnet products take exactly 256.

days.description: Rental term in days: 30, 60, 90 or 360 when the product lists it in terms_days.

tools.name: isp_add_funds
tools.description: [Native ISP] Get a link to add US dollars to the account balance that pays for Native ISP orders and renewals. The person opens the link, chooses card, PayPal or crypto and pays. This balance does not buy residential GB; use residential_top_up for that. Nothing is charged by this tool.

amount_usd.description: US dollars to add, 5 to 10000. Use shortfall_usd from isp_quote_order when topping up for an order.

tools.name: isp_list_orders
tools.description: [Native ISP] List Native ISP orders with status (preparing, active, soon, expired), end date, days left and the issued static IPs. Connections come as JSON, a text export format, or proxy objects for Dolphin Anty, AdsPower or Octo Browser, one per IP. Renewals and new orders are made in the dashboard.

status.description: Only orders with this status. soon means it ends within 3 days.

protocol.description: Connection protocol. Without it each IP comes as SOCKS5 when it has a SOCKS5 port, else as HTTP; the url shows which.

format.description: json (default), a text export format, custom with template, or dolphin, adspower or octo proxy objects.

template.description: Template for format custom, for example %ip%:%port%:%login%:%password%.
